# How to Set Your Company Details


---


## Steps


1.


Go to **Clinic Management > Settings > Appointment**


2.


Enter your **Company Name, Address, Registration Numbers & Bank Details**


****


****


3.


Upload your **Company Logo**


4.


Click **Save**


---


✅ Once saved, these details will appear at your receipts, invoices and all letters.
